key_insight: Direct interpolation followed by constrained optimization enables minimally diffusive ALE remapping that preserves physical bounds and restores global conservation.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports high-order finite element hydrodynamics with large mesh displacements while conserving volume, mass, momentum, and total energy.
method: Transfer fields by direct physical-space interpolation using parallel, GPU-capable routines.
Apply constrained optimization to restore conservation while preserving physical bounds.
Remap integration-point quantities directly without projection onto finite element spaces.
evidence_signal: The method is evaluated on standard two- and three-dimensional remap benchmarks and full ALE hydrodynamics simulations.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify the optimization step's computational cost or parallel scalability.
paper_title: Remap for ALE Hydrodynamics via Direct Interpolation and Constraint Optimization
